regions.full_page: Baby Margaret Mary Stark (18 mo.) enrolled shortly ago for cross- Eyes - now encephilitis of brain in Kiefer Hospital - twenty-four hours more to live. Enrolls PP. SS. Kiefer Hosp. (17th) Deo Gr. decidedly improved. (19th) Fever almost gone, smiles at parents, etc. (2ist) Dr's now decidedly Hopeful of recovery. (Oct. 13) Baby Marg. M. Stark on way home stops for blessing, smiling and bright.
